title: Pocket — Wave 2
track: Track 2: Access and Distribution for MUSD/MEZO

slides.title: Bitcoin capital needs everyday uses.
slides.intro: Mezo lets Bitcoin holders borrow mUSD. Everyday payments still need a clear recipient, a familiar checkout and a reason to acquire that money.

cards.title: Access
cards.body: Social sign-in and an embedded wallet make the first payment easier.

cards.title: Use
cards.body: A merchant invoice gives mUSD a destination beyond transfers among existing holders.

cards.title: Confidence
cards.body: Exact amounts, verified receipts and clear recovery help users trust the outcome.

slides.footer: Pocket turns Mezo access into a practical payment flow.

slides.title: Pocket. Send. Request. Get paid.
slides.intro: One mobile app for mUSD payments and Mezo money management. Users keep funds in their own Privy embedded wallets.

cards.title: Home
cards.body: Send to a username or wallet, create an invoice and follow Activity.

cards.title: Swap
cards.body: Exchange mUSD with BTC, mUSDC or mUSDT through verified Mezo testnet pools.

cards.title: Wealth
cards.body: Manage Savings, MEZO locks and liquidity pools. Borrow against BTC from Home.

slides.footer: Track 2: Access and Distribution for MUSD/MEZO.

slides.title: A payment link that settles in mUSD.
slides.intro: A business creates an invoice, shares its link or QR and receives mUSD directly. Checkout keeps the invoice open through sign-in.

cards.title: Create
cards.body: Business profile, exact mUSD price, description and expiry. Each invoice preserves its merchant-name snapshot.

cards.title: Pay
cards.body: The customer checks the recipient and amount, then signs one direct wallet transfer.

cards.title: Confirm
cards.body: Pocket verifies the transaction and records the paid invoice and Activity together. Recovery uses the existing hash.

slides.footer: Checkout is built. Independent merchant/customer demand still needs pilot evidence.

slides.title: Wallet to wallet, verified on Mezo.
slides.intro: The user wallet holds and signs the funds. Postgres records profiles, invoices and payment outcomes; it does not create spendable money.

cards.title: User wallet
cards.body: Privy sign-in resolves the embedded wallet. Direct payments do not use PocketVault.

cards.title: Mezo
cards.body: mUSD moves on-chain. The payer uses BTC for gas; the recipient needs no transaction.

cards.title: Pocket API
cards.body: Verify sender, token, exact recipient/amount, calldata, receipt and Transfer log. Prevent invoice-proof reuse.

slides.footer: Legacy vault reconciliation is isolated from direct transfers.

slides.title: Deep Mezo integration, from one wallet.
slides.intro: BTC-backed Troves and sMUSD Savings remain central. Wave 2 fixes Savings interest that the stored mapping alone could incorrectly show as zero.

cards.title: Borrow
cards.body: Open, inspect, partially repay or close the owning wallet's Trove. Read protocol debt limits, fees and health.

cards.title: Savings
cards.body: Deposit, withdraw and claim. Total claimable interest includes global-index accrual, with a positive payout simulation.

cards.title: Verified claims
cards.body: Two successful claimYield receipts: 187.366117347141378 and 0.00228183663115 testnet mUSD.

slides.footer: Two claimYield receipts and a live 10-mUSD partial repayment are verified.

slides.title: Manage Mezo assets inside Pocket.
slides.intro: Reviews show amounts, fees, slippage, minimum output and deadlines. Each approval and final action gets a separate user confirmation.

cards.title: Swaps and pools
cards.body: mUSD/BTC, mUSD/mUSDC and mUSD/mUSDT. Add/remove liquidity and claim pool fees; empty pairs cannot swap.

cards.title: MEZO locks
cards.body: Create, top up, extend or withdraw eligible locks. Permanent Start unlock starts a new 208-week wait.

cards.title: Recovery
cards.body: Save pending actions by wallet and chain. Check the existing receipt after reload without signing again.

slides.footer: A live liquidity addition is confirmed. Fork and wallet fixtures cover broader lifecycle behavior.

slides.title: Receipts, checks and an honest baseline.
slides.intro: Specific on-chain actions are verified. Local validation covers payment integrity, merchant profiles, Savings accounting and Wealth recovery.

cards.title: On-chain
cards.body: Two Savings claims, one liquidity addition and a 10-mUSD partial repayment. Debt reduction is verified after interest accrual.

cards.title: Validation
cards.body: 177 passing assertions: 61 Wealth/profile/reward, 59 checkout, 39 payment and 18 reconciliation.

cards.title: Current usage
cards.body: Baseline: 6 personal accounts, 4 faucet claims, 8 direct transfers. Pocket now has a Business profile and a 100-mUSD pilot invoice.

slides.footer: Account counts do not prove independent people. All financial evidence is testnet.

slides.title: Prove a reason to acquire and reuse mUSD.
slides.intro: The product's @musd_pocket Business profile offers a closed-mainnet waitlist pilot at 100 testnet mUSD. Independent customer use remains to be demonstrated.

cards.title: First pilot
cards.body: One builder-operated business and two independent customers, each using their own account and wallet.

cards.title: Measure
cards.body: Settled invoices, distinct independent payers, fulfillment, confusing steps and returning users.

cards.title: Welcome
cards.body: First 20-MEZO claim verified: recipient-owned NFT #941, correct lock and repeat-claim refusal. Four funded claims remain.

slides.footer: Pilot sizes are planning targets. Reward claims and own-wallet tests are not MUSD demand.

slides.title: Merchant fees that can fund useful service.
slides.intro: Proposed disclosed fees on successful merchant payments, with part covering BTC gas sponsorship and operations. Validate pricing with real merchants.

cards.title: Payments
cards.body: Show a merchant fee before payment. Ordinary P2P sends are not the first fee target.

cards.title: Unit economics
cards.body: Measure actual gas and support costs before promising sponsorship or margin.

cards.title: Merchant tools
cards.body: Premium reporting and reconciliation can follow demonstrated demand.

slides.footer: No Pocket fee collection, revenue or universal gas sponsorship is implemented.

slides.title: The build is live. Prove the use.
slides.intro: Builder: greyw0rks · github.com/greyw0rks/musd-pocket. Wave 1 feedback is the checklist for the next delivery.

cards.title: Delivered
cards.body: Merchant + Home/Swap/Wealth build is live. README, pitch deck and on-chain repayment proof are published.

cards.title: Prove
cards.body: Independent customer payments, fulfillment and feedback, followed by returning users. Record tests separately from demand.

cards.title: Complete
cards.body: Reward claim and repayment are verified. Confirm Wave 2 rules/deadline and retain submission confirmation.

slides.footer: mpocket.tech · Source and proof links are in docs/submission/evidence.md.
